validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <state id="p" initial="a">
    <state id="a">
      <transition target="p"/>
    </state>
  </state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: eventless transitions loop forever without consuming an event: `a` -> `a`

primary.message: enters `p`, which lands in `a` by default

notes: each step is the first eventless transition without `cond` on the active state's ancestor chain, so it is always selected; default entry through `initial` targets closes the loop
diagnostics.help: add an `event` or `cond` to one of these transitions, or retarget one so the macrostep can reach a stable configuration
